data.name: Anasuya
data.gender_notes: Anasuya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anasuya is a Sanskrit name, derived from the term anasuya, which means faultless, impeccable, or sinless. In Hindu mythology, Anasuya was a virtuous wife of the sage Atri and the mother of the divine sage Dattatreya. She is known for her immense devotion, purity, and wisdom. The name Anasuya carries the meaning “Faultless, Impeccable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anasuya usually hope their child will grow to embody faultless, impeccable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies purity and devotion
data.etymology: Anasuya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faultless, Impeccable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anasuya total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
